title: Holidays are coming
objectives: express future plans with going to

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Holidays are coming.
Welcome to today's lesson: Holidays are coming! Today we will practice how to express future plans with going to.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Holidays are coming:
express future plans with going to; talk about holiday celebrations

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: holiday, travel, plan, celebrate

teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

Holidays are coming! I am going to travel with my family. We plan to celebrate together.
